H001052.name: Andy Harris
H001052.bio: Republican U.S. Representative for Maryland's 1st district since 2011. He is a physician and served in the Maryland State Senate before Congress.

H000874.name: Steny Hoyer
H000874.bio: Democratic U.S. Representative from Maryland since a 1981 special election. He served as House Majority Leader.

H001096.name: Harriet Hageman
H001096.bio: Republican U.S. Representative for Wyoming's at-large seat since 2023. She is a lawyer from Cheyenne.
